stages.name: keys
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_functions' AS fact FROM py_functions UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_classes' AS fact FROM py_classes UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_decorators' AS fact FROM py_decorators UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_parameters' AS fact FROM py_parameters UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_parameter_annotations' AS fact FROM py_parameter_annotations UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_return_annotations' AS fact FROM py_return_annotations UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_imports' AS fact FROM py_imports UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_bases' AS fact FROM py_bases UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_all' AS fact FROM py_all UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_all_names' AS fact FROM py_all_names UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_modules' AS fact FROM py_modules

stages.name: per_fact
stages.query: SELECT fact,count(*) AS n,min(__path) AS path FROM keys GROUP BY fact

query: SELECT path,0 AS start_byte,0 AS end_byte,fact,n FROM per_fact
